key_terms.غِسْلِينٍ: suppuration or pus-like juice from the tree of Zaqqum

ai.seo_question: What is the food of the people of Hellfire according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the degradation of the disbelievers, whose sustenance is not merely bitter but derived from 'Ghisleen' (pus or slime), symbolizing the impurity of their deeds. This specific description is often linked to the tree of Zaqqum, emphasizing that their punishment is a direct manifestation of their spiritual corruption and rejection of divine truth.
